headline: Curated knowledgebases pair source-linked evidence with LLM search and agentic analysis
label: Curated Knowledgebases With Llm Access
summary: Three 2026 knowledgebase papers add LLM-assisted, source-linked access while preprints test multi-agent LLM frameworks over curated evidence.
synthesis: The dominant thread is the organisation of heterogeneous evidence into queryable, source-linked resources. EVLncRNAs 4.0 updates a curated database of experimentally validated functional lncRNAs and adds RAG-based search with PMID-linked citations. OmniVira provides 8072 source-linked evidence records on viral spillover and cross-species transmission, with LLM-assisted curation. Omni-ARMD couples clinical antimicrobial susceptibility records with gene-level resistance evidence through a log-odds enrichment framework, the one element here extending beyond data integration. The three preprints instead propose agentic systems that draw on curated or traceable evidence: DeepMAST with MCP tools and RAG, SMART applied to 121 studies across six cancer types, and LPT with a curated ~14000-paper literature database. What is new is LLM mediation layered over curated, citable evidence, rather than the curation itself.
